# Week 11

This week we have our guests from [BCEdAccess](https://bcedaccess.com/) joining us. We will join the other cohort at <span class="badge bg-danger">12:00 PM</span> for this session. I will send the Zoom link you later this week. During this class, please make sure to have your cameras on and present yourself professionally.   

[Click here for an article that BCEdAccess has shared as recommended reading in advance of their talk.](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cmadland/edci336/08914f14ac40052598b6362b5cbdbb3b2ca5de6d/posts/1120-week-11/BCEdAccess-Least-Dangerous-Assumption.pdf) Please note that the terminology in the article is outdated since it was written in 2005, but it still is an excellent read.  

Here is a link to a great resource to modernize our language and treat learners with disability respectfully: [A way with words and images: guide for communicating with and about persons with disabilities](https://www.canada.ca/en/employment-social-development/programs/disability/arc/words-images.html)

The province has an [Accessibility and Inclusion Toolkit](https://www2.gov.bc.ca/gov/content/home/accessible-government/toolkit) that is a solid resource for educators as well. 

Please also note that we have two articles on the EDCI 336 website that serve as resources for digital accessibility in education.

- [Web Accessibility – EDCI 336](https://edtechuvic.ca/edci336/2021/02/05/web-accessibility/).  
- [Assistive Technologies – EDCI 336](https://edtechuvic.ca/edci336/2023/11/16/assistive-technologies/).  

Reminder that next week (Nov 27) is our [presentation day for Assignment 2](https://edtechuvic.ca/edci336/assignment-2-educational-technology-presentation-30/).  During that time your groups will share your project work, a very small and informal presentation on what you did for the audio/video project, why you chose to design it in the way it is presented, what tools you used, what you learned along the way, and any recommendations for others.   

I am also opening up meeting bookings for our final assessment meeting (see the [Social Spaces page](https://edtechuvic.ca/edci336/social-spaces-with-colin-fall-2026-a01/)). These are **individual** meetings. Please come with a finished, or nearly finished, Wordpress portfolio. Aim to have this complete before December 8.   

Please know that I am here and happy to help if you are feeling overwhelmed or have questions about the course expectations.
